stories.headline: Samsung Pursues Digital Assets With Crypto Exchange Deal and Stablecoin Push
stories.body: Samsung’s recent announcements that it is adding stablecoin support to new smartphones and that it acquired a stake in cryptocurrency exchange operator Dunamu suggest the company is positioning itself as a leader in stablecoins, CoinDesk reported Tuesday (Aug. 4). stories.headline: Fed gives final approval needed for Santander-Webster merger
stories.body: Banco Santander's pending acquisition of Webster Financial got approval from the Federal Reserve Board about five months after the deal was first announced.
